headline: Chip stocks jump on AI optimism; Dow ends at record high

What type of investment will come in? What is the type of regime that we're likely to see? But I do think the markets are taking more of a [glass] half full approach to this weekend's developments."Still, oil stocks dipped after robust gains in the prior session, with giants Exxon Mobil and Chevron losing about 3.5% and 4.5%, respectively.Renewed AI optimism powered the indexes, with several chip stocks rallying.Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, speaking at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas, gave details about upcoming AI processors that include a new layer of storage technology.SanDisk surged more than 27%, Western Digital jumped 17%, Seagate Technology gained 14% and Micron Technology rose 10%, with all four stocks hitting record highs.But Huang's comments also raised concerns about demand for data center cooling systems. Shares of Johnson Controls slid more than 6%, while Trane Technologies dropped 2.5%.Among other movers, shares of Moderna jumped almost 11% after BofA Global Research raised its price target on the drugmaker.
